dialogue.text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent; just so you know, I'm an AI assistant and this call is recorded. To help me understand your symptoms, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing this rectal bleeding and if you have noticed any recent, unexplained weight loss?
I've been having this rectal bleeding for about two weeks now, and it happens every time I have a bowel movement. No, I haven't noticed any weight loss or anything like that.
Thank you for sharing that. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits, such as new constipation, diarrhea, or a feeling that your bowel doesn't empty completely?
No, I haven't noticed any changes in my bowel habits. Everything seems pretty regular, just the bleeding when I go to the bathroom.
Got it. Is the bleeding bright red or dark red, and do you experience any pain during bowel movements or when touching the mass?
The blood is bright red, and no, I don't have any pain when I go to the bathroom or any other time really.
Thank you for that information. Do you have any family history of colorectal cancer, colon polyps, or other gastrointestinal diseases?
No, I don't have any family history of colon cancer or anything like that. My family has been pretty healthy in that regard.

Thank you for sharing that with me. I would like to order a colonoscopy to evaluate this rectal mass and the source of your bleeding.
